retrievalProfile.description: A tight, high-contrast male portrait featuring a central artist figure with heavy, outlined display typography and a secondary typewriter-style subtitle.
triggerTerms: close-up portrait with heavy outlined text

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly low-angle portrait of a man in a black cap and glasses, framed by a large, white-outlined display name at the bottom and a circular graphic seal on the left, set against a dark, textured background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's hand gesture framing the face
Large display text overlapping the subject's chest
Circular seal graphic integrated into the left mid-ground
coreInvariants: Heavy white outline on primary display text
Dark, desaturated color palette with olive accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, large-scale portrait occupying 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large white-outlined name at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes, down to the hand gesture, then to the large display name, and finally to the typewriter subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject and graphic elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Olive green (subtitle and top banner text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark subject and bright white text elements.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, uniform strokes with a heavy double-outline effect.
Secondary text uses a monospaced typewriter aesthetic with rounded terminals.
Top banner uses a condensed, blocky sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The hyphen in the primary name is elongated to connect characters.
The '4' in the primary name has an open top and sharp geometric angles.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the bottom black margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, geometric display face with a lighter, organic typewriter face.
graphicDevices: Top horizontal banner with beveled ends
Parental advisory box in bottom right

preserve: Olive green color for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, blocky foundation for the display text.
Matches the slab-serif, monospaced look of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with a black cap and glasses, hand near face, against a dark background. Include a white circular etched seal graphic on the left side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white-outlined geometric display text across the bottom chest area. Below it, add a typewriter-style subtitle in olive green.

verificationChecks: Is the display text heavily outlined in white?
Is the subtitle in an olive green typewriter font?
Is the portrait a tight head-and-shoulders shot?
Is there a circular seal graphic on the left?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the primary text outline is distinct and thick.
Ensure the typewriter font is legible against the dark background.
Verify the circular seal does not obscure the subject's face.
Confirm the color palette remains restricted to black, white, and olive.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast urban portrait with heavy-outlined geometric display type and a typewriter-style subtitle for a classic crunk-era aesthetic.
